blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC. Invented procedures for a software demonstration.

Reconcile every bank account to the general ledger each month, within ten business days of the statement date. The adjusted bank balance must equal the adjusted book balance to the cent. No unexplained difference is carried forward.
Record service charges, wire fees and interest credited by the bank in the month they appear on the statement, from the statement itself.

When a check or transfer clears for an amount different from the amount recorded, confirm the amount from the check image and the vendor invoice, then correct the books to the amount that cleared if the bank is right.
A check outstanding more than 90 days is stale. Contact the payee, then void and reissue it or hold it for unclaimed-property review. A stale check is never left outstanding without a note.
A deposit recorded on the last business day may be in transit at month-end. It must clear within five business days of the statement date; one that does not is investigated.
The Controller reviews and signs each reconciliation. Proposed entries are posted only after that review, by the person who posts journal entries.
Appendix A. Accounts Used in Cash Entries

rows: Service charges and wire fees from the statement
Interest the bank credits to an operating account
A check that cleared for more or less than recorded, against the vendor
